notes: Amendment 1's reduction: disagreement is not identifiable.
name: g4_verdict_gse178341_amendment1
purpose: G4 on the real cohort, PER TUMOUR ARM. Supersedes results/2026-08-28_e649023/g4_verdict_gse178341.parquet, which silently used the filtered arm only.
why_superseded: g4_over_rungs did not group by tumour_arm. Its per-patient dedup collapsed two ARM DEFINITIONS rather than duplicate rows, and .first() took filtered in 224 of 224 combinations by file order. Gate memo section 17.1.
population: matched patients only (decision #19); matched = observed in both tissues. 28 matched, 2 excluded.
arms: prereg amendment 1 / decision #15. filtered drops tumour epithelium not called malignant; unfiltered does not. W1's mature_cell_counts emits both and says 'Report both definitions; do not pick one.'
amendment_1_rule: When the arms disagree the pre-committed answer is NOT IDENTIFIABLE, not a choice between them.
verdict: best4 FAILS on both axes under BOTH arms (28/28 filtered, 24/28 unfiltered), resolvable in every case. Every other rung is not_identifiable.
filtered_arm_caveat: Five patients have ZERO epithelium in the filtered arm (C119, C137, C152, C165, C170) — no aneuploid population separated. They enter fraction_below as guaranteed-below on a malignancy-calling fact, which is the failure gate_g4_verdict exists to prevent, one level up.
arithmetic_correction: largest_clean_pass(28) = 8, not 12. The 12 was the n=36 row transplanted onto n=28.
unreconciled: Section 9.1 and gate_g4_verdict's docstring say GSE178341 is '36 of 62 matched'; this table has 30 patients, 28 matched.
